title: Mobile Diablo 2 style ARPG looking for alpha testers.
author: MightyBig-Dev
selftext:
Hello beautiful people of aigamedev. I’ve had this hobby project rolling for a little while and my friends seem to enjoy it. Anyone interested in the following game can DM me for an alpha key. 

\- mobile first portrait   
\- diablo 2 style loot  
\- auto battle + offline continuation   
\- multiplayer online  
\- PlayStation 2 3D graphics   
\- chill idler

The game is called 1 Hand Hero. Hope some of you are interested. Thanks for reading 🙏
